acceptance: `--platform-option force_recreate=true` is accepted and recreates the database without regenerating data
`--force datagen` keeps recreating the database as today
Unit tests cover option parsing and the CLI override merge
context: The Snowflake trial-exit campaign plan's untuned loads pass this option; found by dry run on 2026-10-15.
description: `benchbox run --platform snowflake ... --platform-option force_recreate=true` fails with "Unknown platform option 'force_recreate' for platform 'snowflake'". Adapters read `force_recreate` from config, but the CLI sets it only from `--force datagen` (`benchbox/cli/commands/run.py`, `"force_recreate": s.force_regenerate`), which also regenerates local data. Recreating a database from existing data (for example an untuned load that must replace an old database at sf100) is therefore impossible without a full datagen.
